name: Dune: Awakening
author: ecdemic-afk@users.noreply.github.com
description: Dune: Awakening dedicated server (full battlegroup) on Pterodactyl. One port block, one config file (config/dune.toml), in-place game updates and restarts, health checks and Discord alerts.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Dune: Awakening — Pterodactyl install / reinstall.
#
# Runs in the install container (root, server files at /mnt/server, which is
# /home/container at runtime). Safe to re-run: saves live in server/state/ and
# config/, which this script never deletes, and the database is copied to
# backups/ first.
#
#   1. tools        2. safety backup      3. game files (SteamCMD)
#   4. this project (scripts, runtime, Kubernetes stand-in)
#   5. update tools for in-place updates   6. unpack the game's images
set -euo pipefail

REPO="${SOURCE_REPO:-ecdemic-afk/dune-awakening-ptero}"
REF="${SOURCE_REF:-main}"
case "${BRANCH:-live}" in
    ptc|PTC) APPID=3104830 ;;
    *)       APPID=4754530 ;;
esac
S=/mnt/server
step() { echo; echo "==> $*"; }

step "Installing tools"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
dpkg --add-architecture i386
apt-get update -q
apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates curl tar gzip jq file lib32gcc-s1 libcurl4:i386 patchelf \
    iproute2 gawk python3
mkdir -p "$S/steamcmd" "$S/server" "$S/backups" "$S/config"

if [ -f "$S/server/state/pg/data/PG_VERSION" ]; then
    step "Backing up the game database (saves are never deleted by a reinstall)"
    ts=$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
    tar -czf "$S/backups/pre-reinstall-$ts.tar.gz" -C "$S/server/state" pg/data
    ls -1t "$S"/backups/pre-reinstall-*.tar.gz | tail -n +4 | xargs -r rm -f
fi

step "Downloading the game server (Steam app $APPID, ~5 GB)"
curl -fsSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C "$S/steamcmd"
cd "$S/steamcmd"
# A fresh SteamCMD often fails its first app_update with "Missing
# configuration" (app info not loaded yet in that session). Refresh the app
# info and retry; success is SteamCMD's own "Success!" line, not a folder
# that a previous partial download may have left behind.
steam_ok=0
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    HOME="$S" ./steamcmd.sh +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +force_install_dir "$S/server" \
        +login anonymous +app_info_update 1 +app_update "$APPID" validate +quit \
        2>&1 | tee "$S/steamcmd-install.log" || true
    if grep -qE "Success! App '$APPID' (fully installed|already up to date)" "$S/steamcmd-install.log"; then
        steam_ok=1; break
    fi
    if [ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]; then
        echo "SteamCMD attempt $attempt did not finish — retrying in 20 seconds..."; sleep 20
    fi
done
if [ "$steam_ok" != 1 ] || [ ! -d "$S/server/images" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: the game download failed after 3 attempts (see SteamCMD's output above," >&2
    echo "       also saved to steamcmd-install.log). Run Reinstall to try again." >&2
    exit 1
fi

step "Downloading $REPO@$REF"
SRC=$(mktemp -d)
curl -fsSL "https://codeload.github.com/$REPO/tar.gz/$REF" | tar -xz -C "$SRC"
SRC=$(echo "$SRC"/*)
[ -d "$SRC/core/scripts" ] && [ -d "$SRC/runtime" ] || {
    echo "ERROR: $REPO@$REF does not look like this project — check Source Repository / Source Version" >&2; exit 1; }
rm -rf "$S/scripts" "$S/data" "$S/runtime" "$S/mock-k8s"
cp -r "$SRC/core/scripts" "$S/scripts"
cp -r "$SRC/core/data" "$S/data"
cp -r "$SRC/runtime" "$S/runtime"
cp -r "$SRC/core/mock-k8s" "$S/mock-k8s"
[ -f "$S/.pteroignore" ] || cp "$SRC/egg/pteroignore" "$S/.pteroignore"
chmod +x "$S"/scripts/*.sh "$S"/runtime/dunectl.py

step "Building the Kubernetes stand-in (mock-k8s)"
GO_VERSION="${GO_VERSION:-1.22.7}"
curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go${GO_VERSION}.linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C /usr/local
# Build scratch on the server disk: Wings' /tmp is a small tmpfs.
export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH GOPATH="$S/.gobuild/path" GOCACHE="$S/.gobuild/cache" GOTMPDIR="$S/.gobuild/tmp"
mkdir -p "$GOPATH" "$GOCACHE" "$GOTMPDIR"
(cd "$S/mock-k8s" && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o "$S/scripts/mock-k8s-go" ./cmd/mock-k8s)
rm -rf "$S/.gobuild" /usr/local/go "$SRC"

step "Bundling the tools for in-place game updates"
rm -rf "$S/tools" && mkdir -p "$S/tools/bin" "$S/tools/lib32"
cp -L /usr/bin/patchelf "$S/tools/bin/patchelf"
[ -e /usr/lib32/ld-linux.so.2 ] && cp -rL /usr/lib32/. "$S/tools/lib32/"

step "Unpacking the game's images (several minutes, little output)"
cd "$S"
ln -snfr server depot
bash scripts/install.sh "$S"

step "Install complete — press Start."

variables.name: Self-Host Service Token
variables.description: Your server token from account.duneawakening.com (sign in with the Steam account that owns the game). Every running server needs its own token.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the in-game server browser.

variables.name: Sietch Name
variables.description: Name of your sietch shown in game. Empty = the Server Name. Apply with Pterodactyl's Restart button.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password to join. Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: Region shown in the server browser, e.g. Europe, North America, Asia.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: The IP players connect to. 'auto' detects it. Set it only if auto picks the wrong one.

variables.name: Game Branch
variables.description: live = the normal game, ptc = Public Test. Changing it needs a Reinstall.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 = install game updates automatically when the server starts. 0 = only when you type `update`.

variables.name: Always-Running Maps
variables.description: Maps that run all the time, comma-separated. Every other map (dungeons, story maps, Arrakeen, Harko...) stays cold and starts when a player enters it, then stops when empty. Each running map uses ~5 GB of RAM. Empty = use config/dune.toml. Apply with Pterodactyl's Restart button.

variables.name: Max Running Maps
variables.description: Most maps running at once, always-running ones included. A player entering a cold map beyond this waits for a slot. Size it to your RAM (the health check says what fits).

variables.name: Stop Empty Maps After
variables.description: How long a cold map keeps running after its last player leaves, e.g. 10m, 30m, 1h.

variables.name: Deep Desert Copies
variables.description: Extra Deep Desert instances players can pick, each always running (~5 GB of RAM). 0 = only the main Deep Desert (no instance choice in game). Copies above this number are removed at the next restart.

variables.name: Arrakeen Copies
variables.description: Extra Arrakeen instances, each always running (~5 GB). Copies above this number are removed at the next restart.

variables.name: Harko Village Copies
variables.description: Extra Harko Village instances, each always running (~5 GB). Copies above this number are removed at the next restart.

variables.name: Web Panel Password
variables.description: Password for the web panel at http://<server IP>:<primary port + 32>. Empty = the panel is off. At least 10 characters. The panel has no HTTPS: forward its port only if you need it outside your network.

variables.name: Discord Webhook
variables.description: Optional. A Discord channel webhook URL for alerts (crashes, restarts, updates, backups).

variables.name: Source Repository (advanced)
variables.description: GitHub owner/repo that Reinstall downloads this project from.

variables.name: Source Version (advanced)
variables.description: Branch, tag or commit to install from.
